metadata.title: DGA Latency Microsecond Breakdown & Computational Bypass Profiling
metadata.reference: AR1115 Checklist Item 3 (Adv. Pranav Bhat / IPTTO MAHE)

1_url_normalization_nfc_unquote.operation: Unicode NFC normalization, single-pass unquote, lowercase hostname, default port strip

2_lexical_shannon_entropy.operation: Character histogram tabulation and Shannon entropy H(U) calculation

3_gating_comparator_and_branch.operation: Threshold comparison (H(U) > 4.50) and control branch dispatch

4_feature_registry_and_provenance_sha256.operation: Cryptographic registration of 3 feature nodes and parent DAG SHA-256 calculation

5_fusion_policy_evaluation.operation: Table 6-1 Rule 1 evaluation, emitting WITHHOLD_PARSER_AND_RENDERER directive

6_explanation_synthesis_and_audit.operation: Deterministic rationale compilation, rule attribution, block SHA-256 hash generation

7_html_ast_parsing_and_sdr.operation: HTML AST state machine, tag stack maintenance, void tag filtering, SDR calculation

legal_technical_clarification.item_3_resolution: For a bypassed input, the 3.971 ms latency includes: (1) URL Unicode NFC and RFC 3986 normalization, (2) Shannon entropy histogram calculation, (3) gating condition verification, (4) cryptographic feature registry SHA-256 hashing, (5) deterministic fusion policy evaluation emitting the WITHHOLD directive, and (6) explanation synthesis with canonical audit record serialization. In the absence of the entropy gate, the processor must additionally allocate worker threads and execute full HTML AST tokenization, tag-stack state machine parsing, void tag filtering, and SDR calculation, adding ~2.65 ms of unnecessary computational overhead and bringing total latency to 6.621 ms. The entropy gate physically eliminates this downstream AST workload on DGA traffic, achieving a 40.0% reduction in processing time.
